answer_1.quote: Automatic story generation aims to produce interesting stories to be read by readers or help writers develop new ideas.

answer_2.quote: We measure intra-story lexical diversity using self-BLEU and within-story lexical diversity (or repetition) using distinct-n.

answer_4.quote: We generate 50 stories using each model and invite three crowdworkers to evaluate each story on the following fine-grained aspects: naturalness, interestingness, and cohesiveness.
answer_4.guideline: evaluate each story on the following fine-grained aspects: naturalness, interestingness, and cohesiveness.
